kind: supplementary faithful-formula monthly paper reproduction with explicit universe/execution adaptations
skill_usage: Read report-reproduction/reference methodology; native extract-report; standalone reviewed supplementary formulas/diagnostics, NOT native Ridge prepare/check/evaluate

source.title: Anomalies in the China A-share market
source.holding: Monthly end-of-month sorts, K=1 month, EW deciles, high minus low
source.paper_hac_lag: Not explicitly identified; local lag 3 not claimed original
source.paper_monthly_return_transaction_timesta: Month-end statistical convention; precise execution order not specified

data.calendar_source: Frozen original panel dates, cross-panel identical; observed SSE calendar not exchange-certified
data.source_universe: Frozen SH/SZ master including delisted; known code migration gaps and incomplete terminal coverage, BSE excluded
data.price: raw_close * asof Sina hfq factor; vendor adjusted-price return, not independently certified total shareholder return
data.volume: Actual normalized shares, never multiply by100 again
data.denominator: raw_close * volume_shares, exactly paper proxy, NOT actual amount_cny

candidates.local_missing_rule: Require all20 pairs and21 consecutive global-calendar good prices; volume>0, raw_close>0; no compressed missing-day shifts; no fill

candidates.formula: For target month m, mean of e_i,m-12k where e_i,j=R_i,j-cross_section_mean(R_*,j), using past same calendar months within20years
candidates.historical_cross_section: Each historical month own then-eligible SH/SZ universe and available full calendar-month returns; never future survivor universe
candidates.history: At signal >=60 calendar months since IPO and first observed source date; at least5 valid past same-calendar-month full returns; all available past up to20years, not cherry-picked5; no missing-month fill
candidates.first_month_boundary: 2019-01 requires missing2018-12 close and is invalid; earliest potential full target2024-02, actual eligibility verified
candidates.expected_evaluation_months: 2024-02..2026-10, at most33; materially low statistical power

universe_adaptation.ipo_age: At least6 calendar months for current and historical month-end membership; SEAS additionally5-year observed/IPO history
universe_adaptation.current_gate: Known lifecycle, observed finite positive current bar, bar_good and no flagged >50% adjusted current move; existing data-quality rule, not proof extreme error
paper_filters_not_replicated: Exclude bottom30% A-share total market cap
Historical suspension<5days/month and<120days/year and tradability at rebalance
Value weighting by PIT total market cap
universe_adaptation.no_proxy_claim: Current static classifications/size not substituted. Formula replication is possible; original universe replication is NOT. Small/illiquid-stock confounding unresolved.

monthly_definition.formation: Last global trading day of calendar month, only currently observable fields
monthly_definition.primary_label: Adjusted close at target month end / adjusted close at signal month end -1; statistical association, not same-close executable fill
monthly_definition.open_sensitivity: First global session AFTER signal month end to first global session AFTER next month end, adjusted opens; last target October2026 lacks November open and is immature
monthly_definition.completed_target_months: Through October2026 primary, September2026 open sensitivity; no partial November
monthly_definition.groups: Sort score ascending then instrument lexicographic to break ties; floor(rank0*10/N)+1, N>=100; assign before future labels; equal target weights
monthly_definition.label_missing: Keep intended group membership/weights; report available-return conditional means separately from full-weight known-return contribution and missing weight. Complete portfolio return only when missing weight=0. No missing=0, no post-outcome reranking. Theoretical long-short/IC inference remains conditional on outcome availability and not executable portfolio evidence.
monthly_definition.long_only: D10 and same signal-eligible universe EW; conditional available-return comparison plus missing-weight and full-weight long-only conservative lower bound using unknown returns>=-100%. No market-index claim.
monthly_definition.costs: Fixed target-weight turnover proxy sum abs(w_t-w_prev) each leg, no return-drift adjustment; first formation counted entry. Gross conditional diagnostic minus10/25/50bp times turnover, not actual fills/net portfolio. B-E mean gross conditional spread / mean two-leg turnover proxy; exact paper drift convention not asserted.
monthly_definition.short_sales: D10-D1 theoretical only; no claim A-share borrow availability/financing.

inference.primary: Each candidate mean monthly conditional EW D10-D1 on paper close-close labels; includes all candidate months, not selected regimes
inference.family: 2 one-sided tests, Holm2; preserve both including failure
inference.support_gate: At least24 finite months; mean>0; HAC3 95% lower>0; Holm2 p<=0.05. Passing is retrospective adapted association only, never faithful-universe or tradability certification.
inference.secondary: Pearson/RankIC same monthly labels, mean/std/ICIR/positive rate, HAC3 and separate Holm2 RankIC family; open-label and cost sensitivities descriptive not extra selection
inference.calendar_hac: Use monthly grid with explicit missing values and lag based on calendar distance, not silently compress missing months
inference.stability: All annual blocks, fixed2020-23/2024-25/2026 and matched2024-26 comparison, no winner horizon selection

budget.data_passes: Stock-wise frozen-panel pass, monthly outputs only; no duplicate whole-market native prepare
budget.estimate: Data/formula+tests roughly5-10min; assessment/audit/report roughly10-20min, not guarantee

stop_rule: Run these2 once under fixed definitions; implementation repairs logged/tested, no addedfactor/window/sign search. Negative/inconclusive results delivered; no Site or native finalize.
